concept: A list that stays on the page for choosing one or several options that should all be visible, the rows of Select’s sheet set in a recess.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a native multi-select box (select multiple) with grey highlighted rows as the listbox
default_to_avoid.why_not: the native multiple select needs a modifier key to choose several and draws in the OS look

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the list is a recess carved into the glass, the same groove as a field, so it reads as something to choose in

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: a chosen row is a lighter pane and carries a check, never only a colour

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: arrow keys move, Space or Enter choose, typing jumps to a row

options: A rows in a recess with checks
variants.picked: A rows in a recess with checks
variants.reason: A is Select’s list on the page (D-017), one family. B needs Ctrl to choose several and looks like the OS. C works but loses the single focus stop and typeahead.

root.why: the label and the list, the same gap as every field

label.why: the list’s name in the label size, its accessible name

list.why: an on-page list is a recess carved into the glass, like a field

sheet.why: a popup list is an opaque sheet so its options read on any scene

option.why: each option is a 44px row whose corner nests the sheet’s

active.why: the highlighted row is a lighter pane lit on its top edge

check.why: a chosen row carries a check, a mark rather than a colour

text.why: the label and its optional second line, stacked

optionLabel.why: the option’s label on one line, cut with an ellipsis if it must

description.why: a second line in secondary text that helps the reader choose

empty.why: a line in secondary text when nothing matches what was typed

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring so a keyboard user sees which field or row is active

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours draw the edges and the highlight with system colours

aria-selected=true.why: a chosen row is semibold and carries its check

aria-disabled=true.why: a disabled row uses the shared disabled opacity and cannot be chosen

aria-invalid=true.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words

@sheet-in.why: a popup sheet drops a short way and settles at hover pace
